unknown-selection.purpose: explicit unknown selection mode; unknown is null, never zero and never fit

real-shape-split.purpose: full 512-expert axis split hot 128 / cold 384 over real shard-1 shapes; shapes only and the split is hypothetical

provenance_boundaries.report_fit_means: declared resource arithmetic only; never measured capacity or an achieved placement
provenance_boundaries.report_wall_estimate_means: declared stage and link arithmetic only; never wall-clock measurement, never proof of the >10 tokens/s objective
provenance_boundaries.selection_means: declared item selection; never actual hot residency, routing coverage or load
provenance_boundaries.unknown_means: null, never zero and never fit; partial expert coverage keeps every affected resource unknown

scope_exclusions: No real hot/cold expert split, Strata placement plan or cache-state evidence is accepted here; the 128/384 split is hypothetical.
No packed tensor, GGUF file, artifact hash, expert mapping, router logit or measurement is read or authenticated by the validator.
schema-version-1 files stay byte-identical, including the v1 design document; v2 adds a separate schema, validator, fixtures, acceptance record and design document.
A fit or unknown result is declaration arithmetic, not device capacity, bandwidth, wall time or the >10 tokens/s objective.
The real input still needs an actual hot/cold split plus independently reviewed Strata placement and measured target evidence under a separately authorized operation.
This record does not close the acceptance of issue #6 or issue #20; it is source-only declaration evidence and cannot move the measured parent gate.
